questions.q: The deltoid muscle is supplied by the:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. Injured in shoulder dislocation and surgical-neck fractures.

questions.q: While a woman is on magnesium sulphate, the first clinical sign of toxicity to watch for is:
questions.why: Knee jerk disappears at serum levels around 10 mEq/L, before respiratory depression; so the reflex is checked before every repeat dose.

questions.q: In Kent's eighth observation, patients who prove every remedy they receive are:
opts: oversensitive, idiosyncratic patients who are often incurable
patients who need repeated high doses
patients with a purely acute disease
questions.why: Kent: some patients prove every remedy; they are oversensitive and idiosyncratic, and such cases are often incurable; lower potencies are used.

questions.q: A haughty, proud woman who looks down on others, with numbness and over-sensitive genitals, calls for:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Platina's pride and contempt.

questions.q: Acute fright and fear of death immediately after an accident, with great anxiety and restlessness, calls for:
questions.why: Aconite suits sudden, violent shock with intense fear of death.

questions.q: Long-standing PCOS with chronic anovulation increases the risk of:
questions.why: Unopposed oestrogen without progesterone leads to endometrial hyperplasia and carcinoma.

questions.q: Hahnemann's Calcarea carbonica is prepared from:
opts: native chalk dug from the earth
the outer dark layer of the oyster shell
the middle, snow-white layer of the oyster shell
questions.why: Calcarea carbonica (Calcarea ostrearum) is the impure calcium carbonate of the middle snow-white layer of the oyster shell.

questions.q: Hahnemann's first index of symptoms appeared as Part 2 of:
opts: the first edition of the Organon
questions.why: The second part of the Fragmenta (1805) was an index of symptoms, the forerunner of the repertory.

questions.q: Desire to be magnetised, sympathetic nature, fear of thunderstorms and of being alone, and burning pains point to:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Phosphorus: wants company and sympathy.

questions.q: The process of matching the patient's symptoms with the materia medica after repertorisation is called:
opts: final selection by consulting the materia medica
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. The repertory narrows, the materia medica decides.
